changeSet.sql: UPDATE msedcl_invoices SET invoice_no = CONCAT(consumer_no_snapshot, '/', DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y%m%d'), '/', id)

UPDATE customer_msedcl_details d JOIN (SELECT msedcl_detail_id, invoice_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msedcl_detail_id ORDER BY billing_date DESC, id DESC) AS row_num FROM msedcl_invoices) i ON i.msedcl_detail_id = d.id AND i.row_num = 1 SET d.last_invoice_no = i.invoice_no
